claims.claim: M33 X-7 excludes boson masses in range [1.40e-13, 4.06e-12] eV at 95% CL
IRAS 09149-6206 excludes boson masses in range [1.08e-19, 3.45e-19] eV at 95% CL
claims.verification: Direct computation from 10000 posterior samples (subsampled to 2000)

claims.claim: Maximum exclusion probability for M33 X-7 is 100% at μ ≈ 1.66e-13 eV
claims.verification: All posterior samples fall in exclusion region at this mass

claims.claim: Maximum exclusion probability for IRAS 09149-6206 is 99.75% at μ ≈ 1.72e-19 eV
claims.verification: Nearly all posterior samples fall in exclusion region

claims.claim: Self-interaction coupling f_a constraints derived from Bosenova criterion
claims.verification: Computed from posterior samples using Arvanitaki et al. Eq. 48

claims.claim: Stellar-mass BHs probe boson masses ~10^{-14} to 10^{-11} eV
claims.evidence: Consistent with Arvanitaki et al. 2011 and Stott 2018
claims.verification: From gravitational coupling α = GMμ/(ℏc) matching BH size

claims.claim: SMBHs probe boson masses ~10^{-20} to 10^{-16} eV
claims.verification: From gravitational coupling scaling with BH mass
